request.description:
# API 17 — GET /api/superadmin/partner/kpis/ (ranked leaderboard)

**Purpose:** Returns a ranked, paginated list of delivery partners by KPI within a time window.

Requires `Authorization: {{admin_token}}`.

## Query parameters

| Param | Values | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| `ordering` | `delivered`, `assigned`, `rejected`, `failed`, `rejection_rate`, `delivery_success_rate`, `on_time_rate`, `avg_rating`, `avg_delivery_hours`, `avg_response_minutes` | Sort key. Prefix with `-` for descending (e.g. `-delivered`). Default: `-delivered`. A bad value returns **400** listing the allowed keys. |
| `period` | `today`, `week`, `month` | Time window. `week` = rolling 7 days, `month` = rolling 30 days (**default**). |
| `from_date` & `to_date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Custom range. **Both required together** and override `period`. `from_date` must be `<=` `to_date`, else **400**. |
| `page` | integer | Page number (standard pagination). |
| `page_size` | integer | Items per page (standard pagination). |

> **No search, and no filter by port / capability / availability / status.** The list is ordering + time-window + pagination only.

> **Only partners with activity in the window appear** — a partner who did nothing is omitted (padding with zero-rows would make every rate look like a failure).

## Metrics & the null-vs-0 rule

A rate is **`null`** when it has **no samples**, and **`0`** only when it was measured and is genuinely zero. `null` means **'no data'**, not **'bad'**. Every rate ships with its denominator so you can see the sample size.

| Metric | Formula |
|--------|---------|
| `rejection_rate` | `rejected / assigned` |
| `delivery_success_rate` | `delivered / (delivered + failed)` |
| `on_time_rate` | `on_time_deliveries / sla_bound_deliveries` — only express/emergency/fastest orders are SLA-bound; `sla_bound_deliveries` is the denominator |
| `avg_delivery_hours` | `Σ delivery seconds / count / 3600` |
| `avg_response_minutes` | `Σ response seconds / responded_count` |
| `avg_rating` / `ratings_count` | `Σ ratings / count` |
| `tag_counts` | delivery-rating quick-tags |

## Counter bases

`assigned` counts **assignments opened in the window**, while `delivered` / `rejected` count **milestones reached in the window**. An assignment opened last month but delivered this month lands in `delivered` without adding to `assigned`.

That is why a partner can show `delivered: 1`, `rejected: 1`, `assigned: 0` and `rejection_rate: null` — there were 0 assignments opened in the window to key the rate off.

request.description:
# API 18 — GET /api/superadmin/partner/kpi-detail/?user_id=<uuid> (one partner + trend)

**Purpose:** Returns KPIs for a single partner plus a day-by-day time series (**trend**).

## Query Parameters

| Param | Values | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| `user_id` | UUID | **Required.** UUID of the partner. `400` if missing; `404` if unknown/deleted. |
| `period` | `today`, `week` (rolling 7 days), `month` (rolling 30 days, **default**) | Time window. |
| `from_date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Custom range start. Both `from_date` and `to_date` are required together; overrides `period`. `from_date` must be `<= to_date` else `400`. |
| `to_date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Custom range end. Required with `from_date`. Overrides `period`. |

> There is **no ordering or pagination** (single partner).

> **Trend:** Adds a day-by-day series (trend), capped at **180 days** — beyond that the series is `[]` and `series_truncated: true`.

> **Any partner:** Unlike the leaderboard list, this works for any partner, returning a zero-row if they had no activity in the window.

## Metrics & the null-vs-0 rule

A rate is `null` when it has **no samples**, and `0` only when it was **measured and is genuinely zero**. `null` = "no data", **not** "bad". Every rate ships with its denominator.

| Metric | Formula |
|--------|---------|
| `rejection_rate` | `rejected / assigned` |
| `delivery_success_rate` | `delivered / (delivered + failed)` |
| `on_time_rate` | `on_time_deliveries / sla_bound_deliveries` (only express/emergency/fastest orders are SLA-bound; `sla_bound_deliveries` is the denominator) |
| `avg_delivery_hours` | `Σ delivery seconds / count / 3600` |
| `avg_response_minutes` | `Σ response seconds / responded_count` |
| `avg_rating` / `ratings_count` | `Σ ratings / count` |
| `tag_counts` | delivery-rating quick-tags |

### Worked example — DP-00002 (Abhishek)

- `rejection_rate` → **null** (`assigned` is `0` in window, nothing to divide by)
- `delivery_success_rate` → **100.0** (1 of 1 concluded deliveries succeeded)
- `on_time_rate` → **0.0** (measured: 1 SLA-bound delivery, 0 on time)
- `avg_delivery_hours` → **483.6** (~20 days, seed-data artifact)
- `avg_response_minutes` → **null** (no first-action timestamp)
- `avg_rating` / `ratings_count` → **null / 0** (no ratings yet)
- `tag_counts` → **{}**

## Counter bases

`assigned` counts **assignments opened** in the window, while `delivered`/`rejected` count **milestones reached** in the window. An assignment opened last month but delivered this month lands in `delivered` **without** adding to `assigned`.

That is why `delivered: 1`, `rejected: 1`, `assigned: 0` with `rejection_rate: null` is **not** a contradiction (0 assignments opened in the 30-day window to key the rate off).

## API 10 · Picking-slip PDF (admin)

`GET /api/superadmin/orders/order/<order_id>/slip/` · View: `AdminDownloadOrderSlipView`

Streams the same PDF as API 4, but for **any** order (admin scope). One document, two audiences — shared template + service.

**Headers**: `Authorization: Token <key>` required. NOTE: `server-secret-key` is **NOT** required — `/api/superadmin/…` endpoints are exempt from it.

request.description:
POST /api/superadmin/orders/order/<order_id>/refund/ — Refund a paid order.

Two modes, chosen by whether `amount` is present in the body:

A. Full refund (no `amount`): applies the status+time policy; refunds the initial payment plus every settled delta, reverses points + coupon, and moves the order to `refunded`.

B. Partial refund (include `amount`): refunds the specified amount.

Body fields (full refund):
- `reason` (string, required): Recorded on the refund and shown to the sailor.
- `override` (bool-ish, optional): `true`/`1`/`yes` forces a refund past the auto window.

Auth: Authorization: {{admin_token}}.
